activities.title: Introduce yourself
activities.objective: Introduce yourself using basic personal and professional information.
activities.instructions: Speak in English for 30 to 60 seconds.
activities.task: Say your name, your job, what you teach or work with, and one thing you enjoy doing.
activities.objectiveEs: Preséntate usando información personal y profesional básica.
activities.instructionsEs: Habla en inglés durante 30 a 60 segundos.
activities.taskEs: Di tu nombre, tu trabajo, qué enseñas o con qué trabajas y una cosa que disfrutas hacer.

criteria.label: states what or who they work with

activities.title: Talk about your family
activities.objective: Talk about close family members using simple connected sentences.
activities.instructions: Speak in English for 45 to 90 seconds.
activities.task: Talk about two family members. Say who they are, what they usually do, and one thing they like.
activities.objectiveEs: Habla sobre familiares cercanos usando oraciones sencillas conectadas.
activities.instructionsEs: Habla en inglés durante 45 a 90 segundos.
activities.taskEs: Habla sobre dos familiares. Di quiénes son, qué hacen normalmente y una cosa que les gusta.

criteria.label: gives simple information about what they do

activities.title: Describe your daily routine
activities.objective: Describe a normal weekday using simple present sentences and time expressions.
activities.instructions: Speak in English for 45 to 90 seconds.
activities.task: Describe a normal weekday. Say when you get up, what you do during the day, and what you usually do in the evening.
activities.objectiveEs: Describe un día normal entre semana usando oraciones en presente simple y expresiones de tiempo.
activities.instructionsEs: Habla en inglés durante 45 a 90 segundos.
activities.taskEs: Describe un día normal entre semana. Di a qué hora te levantas, qué haces durante el día y qué haces normalmente en la noche.

criteria.label: uses at least one time expression

activities.title: Talk about likes and dislikes
activities.objective: Talk about personal likes and dislikes and give simple reasons.
activities.instructions: Speak in English for 45 to 90 seconds.
activities.task: Talk about three things you like and two things you dislike. Give a simple reason for at least two of them.
activities.titleEs: Habla sobre lo que te gusta y lo que no te gusta
activities.objectiveEs: Habla sobre tus gustos y disgustos personales y da razones sencillas.
activities.instructionsEs: Habla en inglés durante 45 a 90 segundos.
activities.taskEs: Habla sobre tres cosas que te gustan y dos que no te gustan. Da una razón sencilla para al menos dos de ellas.

criteria.label: gives reasons for at least two preferences

activities.title: Understand classroom instructions
activities.objective: Identify the key steps in a short spoken classroom instruction.
activities.objectiveEs: Identificar los pasos principales de una instrucción oral breve.
activities.instructions: Read the short transcript aloud or use device text-to-speech, then answer the question.
activities.instructionsEs: Lee el texto en voz alta o usa la lectura en voz alta del dispositivo y responde la pregunta.
activities.task: Transcript: First, connect the sensor. Then open the program. Finally, test the robot. What should you do first?
activities.taskEs: Transcripción: Primero, conecta el sensor. Luego abre el programa. Finalmente, prueba el robot. ¿Qué debes hacer primero?

activities.title: Read a project update
activities.objective: Find the main idea and a detail in a short project update.
activities.objectiveEs: Encontrar la idea principal y un detalle en una actualización breve.
activities.instructions: Read the message and answer the question.
activities.instructionsEs: Lee el mensaje y responde la pregunta.
activities.task: The robotics team tested a sensor on Tuesday. It worked indoors, but sunlight affected readings outside. The team will test a cover next week. What problem did the team find?
activities.taskEs: El equipo de robótica probó un sensor el martes. Funcionó en interiores, pero la luz solar afectó las lecturas en exteriores. El equipo probará una cubierta la próxima semana. ¿Qué problema encontró?

activities.title: Write a learning update
activities.objective: Write a short connected update using a past event and a next step.
activities.objectiveEs: Escribir una actualización breve usando un hecho pasado y un siguiente paso.
activities.instructions: Write 3–4 sentences about what you practised, one difficulty and what you will do next.
activities.instructionsEs: Escribe 3–4 oraciones sobre lo que practicaste, una dificultad y lo que harás después.
activities.task: Describe what you practised, what was difficult, what helped, and your next step.
activities.taskEs: Describe qué practicaste, qué fue difícil, qué te ayudó y tu siguiente paso.

activities.title: Choose a verb pattern
activities.objective: Choose a reviewed verb pattern in a controlled sentence.
activities.objectiveEs: Elegir un patrón verbal revisado en una oración controlada.
activities.instructions: Choose the correct option and explain why.
activities.instructionsEs: Elige la opción correcta y explica por qué.
activities.task: I use this app ___ practise English. (to / for / at)
activities.taskEs: Uso esta aplicación ___ practicar inglés. (to / for / at)

criteria.label: uses to + base verb for purpose

activities.title: Build useful collocations
activities.objective: Recognize natural collocations for learning and technology.
activities.objectiveEs: Reconocer combinaciones naturales sobre aprendizaje y tecnología.
activities.instructions: Choose the natural phrase and use it in a sentence.
activities.instructionsEs: Elige la expresión natural y úsala en una oración.
activities.task: Choose: make progress / do progress / take progress.
activities.taskEs: Elige: make progress / do progress / take progress.

activities.title: Make key words clear
activities.titleEs: Pronuncia con claridad las palabras clave
activities.objective: Practise sentence stress in a short statement.
activities.objectiveEs: Practicar el acento de frase en una afirmación breve.

activities.instructionsEs: Grábate diciendo la oración dos veces, enfocándote en las palabras clave.
activities.task: I BUILT a ROBOT yesterday. Focus on BUILT and ROBOT.
activities.taskEs: I BUILT a ROBOT yesterday. Enfatiza BUILT y ROBOT.

activities.title: Ask for clarification
activities.objective: Repair a communication breakdown with a polite clarification request.
activities.objectiveEs: Resolver una dificultad comunicativa mediante una petición cortés.
activities.instructions: Imagine a colleague gives an instruction you do not understand. Respond politely.
activities.instructionsEs: Imagina que un compañero da una instrucción que no entiendes. Responde con cortesía.
activities.task: Use “Could you repeat that, please?” or “What do you mean by…?”
activities.taskEs: Usa “Could you repeat that, please?” o “What do you mean by…?”.

activities.title: Explain a problem and solution
activities.titleEs: Explica un problema y una solución
activities.objective: Explain a problem, its cause and a proposed solution in a connected paragraph.
activities.objectiveEs: Explicar un problema, su causa y una solución propuesta en un párrafo conectado.

activities.instructionsEs: Escribe 5–6 oraciones. Usa because y however o therefore.

activities.taskEs: Una actividad de aprendizaje da retroalimentación poco clara. Explica el problema, su efecto y una solución práctica.
